doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02

title: Photographs: Pensacola beach, hotel and Naval Station
summary: Looking at postcards and photos, they place Sanders Beach, the St. Carlos Hotel and the Naval Station auditorium in Pensacola where they played.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Well these are places where you played.
Yeah, this is a beach there. Older about Pensacola.

Yeah. Sanders Beach. Yeah, I played there. Municipal Bathing Beach, Sanders Beach, and where's the band play? Yeah, that's the building there. That's the dancing building in there. Yeah. Well maybe I can get a picture of this someplace too. That's the regular postcard. I've seen some of it. Sanders Beach. I played at the St. Carlos Hotel there.
San Carlos, that was right in the... That's on Palafal Street in Pensacola, Florida. Pensacola, uh huh.
Yeah, right by a church. Yeah. And this shows all the pictures along the gulf there. Your hometown was right on the gulf too, was it? Right near the water? That's right.
I played at the Naval Station. The Naval Station, yes, in Pensacola.

Did you play that at the big auditorium there? That's where I played at, the big auditorium. Oh, the big auditorium at the Naval Station. Yeah, indeed. That was the time then, I'm telling you. That's a big place. Yeah, indeed. That's a nice folder to have. You might show us some more of these pictures.
Yeah, I'm looking through them, I'm sure. I'll put this in with that. Yeah, that's why I keep them all in together, you know.
